 AFCON 2027: Eleven more players arrive in Kinshasa as Sierra Leone camp swells to 21
 📅 November 10, 2026 
  • 
 👤 Kabuma Node 
  • 
 📁 AFCON 
  • 
 🕑 2 min read 
 Eleven additional players arrived in Kinshasa on Monday night to join the Sierra Leone national team Leone Stars camp, bringing the total number of players in camp to 21 out of the 25-man squad.
 The arrivals include 𝐂𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐎𝐬𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐊𝐚𝐤𝐚𝐲, 𝐉𝐮𝐦𝐚 𝐁𝐚𝐡, 𝐈𝐝𝐫𝐢𝐬 𝐊𝐚𝐧𝐮, 𝐀𝐮𝐠𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐬 𝐊𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐛𝐨, 𝐒𝐮𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐲 𝐊𝐚𝐢𝐤𝐚𝐢, 𝐀𝐥𝐢 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐡, 𝐑𝐚’𝐞𝐞𝐬 𝐁𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐮𝐫𝐚-𝐖𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐚𝐦𝐬, 𝐓𝐲𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐡, 𝐀𝐥𝐡𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐧 𝐊𝐨𝐫𝐨𝐦𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐞𝐥 𝐊𝐚𝐧𝐮 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝐁𝐞𝐤𝐨𝐞.
 Upon arrival, the players were warmly received at the hotel lobby by officials of the Leone Stars delegation, including 𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐂𝐨𝐚𝐜𝐡 𝐃𝐢𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐫 𝐆𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐳 𝐃𝐚 𝐑𝐨𝐬𝐚 and the newly appointed Leone Stars Ambassador and former captain, 𝐔𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐮 “𝐙𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐲” 𝐁𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐮𝐫𝐚.
 The team continues to intensify preparations ahead of Thursday’s crucial 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟕 𝐀𝐟𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐚 𝐂𝐮𝐩 𝐨𝐟 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 (𝐀𝐅𝐂𝐎𝐍) 𝐐𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐃𝐑 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐨. The remaining four players are expected to arrive in camp later today as the squad moves closer to full strength ahead of the highly anticipated encounter.
 Meanwhile, following 𝐌𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐢 𝐉𝐨𝐧𝐞𝐬’ last-minute withdrawal due to “𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐨𝐧𝐬”, Sierra Leone National U-20 team star 𝐏𝐚𝐩𝐚𝐲 𝐆𝐮𝐦𝐛𝐚 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐲 has been called up as his replacement. The Ports Authority winger is already with the team in Kinshasa and is set to make his first appearance in the senior national team setup.
 Sierra Leone will face DR Congo away in the first leg on 𝐓𝐡𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐝𝐚𝐲, 𝐍𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫 𝟏𝟐, 𝐢𝐧 𝐊𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐬𝐚, before meeting the Congolese side in the return leg on 𝐓𝐮𝐞𝐬𝐝𝐚𝐲, 𝐍𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫 𝟏𝟕, 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔, 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐚, 𝐌𝐨𝐫𝐨𝐜𝐜𝐨.
 The Leone Stars delegation is accommodated at the five-star 𝐆𝐨𝐥𝐝𝐞𝐧 𝐓𝐮𝐥𝐢𝐩 𝐊𝐢𝐧-𝐎𝐚𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝐇𝐨𝐭𝐞𝐥 in Kinshasa as preparations continue for the crucial AFCON qualifying encounters.
